requirements.text: The system shall ensure users can borrow a maximum of 5 books simultaneously and revoke borrowing privileges for members with outstanding overdue books.
The system shall automatically notify members of overdue books via digital notifications within 24 hours of the due date.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books and log all transactions for audit purposes.
The system shall implement a user authentication process and require strong password policies for member accounts.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding library services.
The system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.
